test_f_gold_valid_sentence: test f_gold with a valid sentence like 'I love cinema.' and expect True
test_f_gold_invalid_sentence: test f_gold with an invalid sentence like 'I lovE cinema.' and expect False
review_f_gold_grammar_rules: review f_gold to understand the finite state machine grammar validation rules
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which validates sentences starting with uppercase and ending with a period
refactor_f_gold_state_machine: refactor f_gold to use a named state machine instead of integer state codes
